scene.bubble: Kili has brought postcards from five different countries — and one is for us, from Grandpa Sven in Norway!

activities.title: Read Grandpa Sven's postcard and choose the right answer.

data.instructions: Read the text. Choose the correct answer.
data.text: Dear explorers! Greetings from Norway! Yesterday I sailed my little red boat into a fjord so deep that the mountains touched the clouds. I saw seven waterfalls and one very fat seal — he slept on a rock all afternoon, like a king. Tonight I'll try to see the northern lights. The sky here is green and purple at night, like magic! I'm sending you a small parcel with real fjord stones. Big hugs, Grandpa Sven.

items.sentence: How many waterfalls did he see?
What did the fat seal do?

activities.title: Listen. Where did the postcards come from? Write a word in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Ingrid (leyendo) y Kili (orgulloso del reparto).
data.script: Ingrid: Five postcards today! Great work, Kili. … Ingrid: The first one is from Japan — there's a photo of a white mountain on it. … Ingrid: The second comes from Egypt. Aunt Nora visited the pyramids by camel! … Ingrid: This one is from Brazil, from the carnival. The stamp has a green parrot. … Ingrid: Number four is from Canada. Uncle Tom saw a real bear from the train! … Ingrid: And the last one… from Norway! Grandpa Sven says he's sending us fjord stones. … Ingrid: Let's put them all on the classroom map!
